correctness.rationale: Uniform convergence of H(x)=sum_j (-1)^j x^{underline j} follows from j! divisibility, while divided differences converge since deleting one of j consecutive factors retains factorial divisibility. Odd H' is 1 mod 2; even H' is 2 mod 4, giving exact 2-adic distance laws on odd inputs and even inputs within a mod-4 class. Rescaled branches F_odd, F_0, F_2 are isometric bijections of Z_2; this yields each even residue once, each 1 mod 8 four times and no other fibers. Difference valuation also proves least period 2^k and closure support has measure 5/8. Independent full-fiber recurrence checks k=1..10 passed, distinct from the global proof.
